expectations.text: The response asks what decision or problem the analysis should support
expectations.evidence: “这份东西最后支撑哪个决定？定价、定位、融资故事、路线图，还是销售对战卡？”

expectations.text: The response does not treat the listed dimensions as a complete task definition
expectations.evidence: “有产品、有客群、有"这 5 家是谁"，才能谈功能/定价/优缺点”，并询问目的、背景、材料、边界和完成标准。

expectations.text: The response does not invent competitor data
expectations.evidence: 未提供任何具体竞品的功能、价格或业绩数据；明确询问“哪 5 家”，并说明内部材料“没有就留空，我不会填”。
